validation_results.failure: Diglett carried damage from Voltorb above the two-thirds recovery cutoff into Pikachu, whose priority attack knocked it out before the next Dig could establish its PP proof.

diagnosis: The teacher funded two Surge recoveries but used an HP threshold tuned to previously observed damage. A fragile newly caught Diglett could legally survive the first opponent above that threshold yet remain vulnerable to Pikachu's priority move after the opponent transition.
repair_direction: At a stable MAIN boundary, restore any missing Diglett HP before selecting Dig, while retaining the existing two-item cap and exact inventory accounting. This protects the intended Ground-type lesson without switching to a reserve or weakening the evidence contract.
